overview.title: Beyond equipment, mindset is combat power
overview.description: For high-risk missions, strong mental fitness and team cohesion matter as much as physical skill. Expansion facilities help teams face fear and push limits within safe, controlled boundaries.
overview.lead: From high-altitude bridge crossings to team trust exercises — systematically building will, courage, stress tolerance, and coordination.
overview.body: Complete protection and fall-arrest systems keep high-intensity psychological challenges within safe boundaries.
